findings.title: Command uses a shell operator with no shell
findings.cause: container worker runs echo starting && sleep 3600 with no shell: && is a shell operator (run the next command if the first succeeds), and without a shell it is one more argument to echo, so what follows it never runs as a command; its log shows the operator as text: "starting && sleep 3600"; Deployment worker has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container worker exited with code 0 (Completed), restarted 5 times
last lines of container worker's log (current run)
container worker's command and args are a list with "&&" as one item, and no shell

findings.fix: Run the line through a shell: command: ["sh", "-c", "echo starting && sleep 3600"] (if the image has a shell), or run one program only and move the other step into an init container or the image.
